text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
What should I do, Trainerrrr...? It's my 
turn to clean the storage room, but... ya 
know, I've been busy? So I haven't done 
it~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
We've got training too, so starting this 
now makes time super tight, right? But if 
we do it together, it'll be twice as fast! 
Pure genius, don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Pleeease! Help me out!! Seriously, just a 
teeeeny-tiiiny bit!! I'll pay you back! 
Definitely maybe!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I don't have anyone else to ask, so... 
please! You'll help me... won't you? 
Pretty please? ♡
